compact/powershell/claude-code/vllm-embe.copy:
# Keep generated configuration files out of version control.
if (-not (Test-Path .gitignore)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path .gitignore | Out-Null }
Add-Content -Path .gitignore -Value '.chunkhound.json'
# Configure ChunkHound with vLLM embeddings and Anthropic for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/
# You'll need: Anthropic API key
@'
{
  "embedding": {
    "provider": "openai",
    "model": "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B",
    "base_url": "http://localhost:8000/v1",
    "rerank_model": "Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B",
    "rerank_url": "http://localhost:8001/v1/rerank",
    "rerank_format": "cohere"
  },
  "llm": {
    "provider": "anthropic",
    "api_key": "<YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY>"
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path '.chunkhound.json' -Encoding utf8
# Configure Claude Code to connect to ChunkHound via MCP.
claude mcp add ChunkHound -- chunkhound mcp
# Build ChunkHound's search index for this project.
chunkhound index .
